chunks: Surely We are able to reform even his finger-tips.

key_terms.بَنَانَهُ: His fingertips/toes (the extremities of the hand or foot)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's ability to resurrect the human body?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Qiyamah is often cited to affirm the physical reality of resurrection, countering dualistic views that might dismiss bodily restoration. The phrase 'qadirina ala an nusawwiya bananahu' underscores God's precision in reassembling even the minutest details, such as the fingertips, serving as a tangible proof for the Day of Judgment.
